component.name: Klient
component.summary: Mail client with PGP, an AI assistant and an AI spam filter
E-mailový klient s PGP, AI asistentem a AI spamfiltrem

description.p: A GNOME mail client for Proton Mail (directly over its API, without Proton Bridge), Gmail, Seznam.cz and any IMAP/SMTP mailbox.
E-mailový klient pro GNOME pro Proton Mail (přímo přes jeho API, bez Proton Bridge), Gmail, Seznam.cz a libovolnou schránku IMAP/SMTP.

ul.li: End-to-end encryption on Proton and PGP/MIME for the other services, with automatic key discovery
End-to-end šifrování u Protonu a PGP/MIME u ostatních služeb s automatickým hledáním klíčů
AI assistant and AI-driven spam filter with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Mistral or a local model (Ollama); new mail appears only after the spam check
AI asistent a spamfiltr řízený AI s Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Mistralem nebo lokálním modelem (Ollama); nová pošta se ukáže až po kontrole spamu
Conversations, safe HTML mail with remote content blocked, rich-text editor, scheduled sending and snoozing
Vlákna, bezpečné HTML zprávy s blokovaným vzdáleným obsahem, formátovaný editor, naplánované odeslání a odkládání
Encrypted offline cache, rules, undo send, calendar invitations, background mode with a tray icon
Šifrovaná offline cache, pravidla, zpoždění odeslání, pozvánky do kalendáře, běh na pozadí s ikonou v liště
Available in English and Czech; updates itself from GitHub
Česky a anglicky; aktualizuje se sám z GitHubu

screenshot.caption: The main window with a conversation
Hlavní okno s konverzací
The AI spam filter moved a scam to Spam
Spamfiltr s AI přesunul podvod do Spamu

description.p: Only the configured AI models are used, and every AI request is recorded in the log.
Používají se jen nastavené modely AI a každý požadavek na AI se zapisuje do logu.
The spam filter's reason is always written in the interface language.
Zdůvodnění spamfiltru je vždy v jazyce rozhraní.
AI summaries are always written in the interface language.
Shrnutí od AI jsou vždy v jazyce rozhraní.
Servers with an expired or self-signed certificate: the certificate can be reviewed and trusted.
Servery s vypršelým nebo vlastnoručně podepsaným certifikátem: certifikát jde prohlédnout a označit jako důvěryhodný.
Help opens in its own window, so switching its language works on Ubuntu too.
Nápověda se otevírá ve vlastním okně, takže přepnutí jazyka funguje i na Ubuntu.
A new General page in Preferences for the language, background mode and updates.
Nová stránka Obecné v Předvolbách pro jazyk, běh na pozadí a aktualizace.
A package for Ubuntu 26.04 LTS and newer, with automatic updates through apt.
Balíček pro Ubuntu 26.04 LTS a novější s automatickými aktualizacemi přes apt.
Fixes empty one-line messages and dates in the English interface; adds screenshots and a demo mode.
Opravuje prázdné jednořádkové zprávy a data v anglickém rozhraní; přidává snímky obrazovky a ukázkový režim.
What's New after an update and before installing one.
Co je nového po aktualizaci i před její instalací.
Klient speaks English and Czech; the AI answers in the interface language too.
Klient mluví anglicky a česky; stejným jazykem odpovídá i AI.
Automatic updates from GitHub: new versions are downloaded and verified in the background and installed with one click.
Link to the source code on GitHub in About.
Help in the main menu (F1) opens the user documentation.
The spam-filter status shows the currently chosen AI model.
Monochrome panel icon with a red dot for new mail; user documentation.
Mistral AI (EU servers) as an AI provider; Ministral 3 available as a local model.
Gmail labels, archive and starred folder work like on the Gmail web.
Attachments at the top of messages; no more jumping back to the top while reading.
PGP encryption and signatures for Seznam, Gmail and IMAP accounts; used space for servers without a quota; consistent preferences.
Seznam, Gmail and IMAP accounts get conversation threads, snooze and scheduled sending.
Clearer Seznam login with two-factor authentication; full error messages.
Other mail services: Seznam.cz, Gmail (app password) and any IMAP/SMTP mailbox, with automatic setup and instant new-mail notification after the spam check.
Preparation for other mail services; service logos in the account switcher.
Author's website and contact in the About dialog.
New mail appears only after the spam filter has checked it, so spam never flashes up in the inbox.
The storage indicator matches Proton's web, refreshes regularly and turns orange or red when the mailbox is nearly full.
Faster local AI: summaries and label suggestions are remembered, summaries of new mail are prepared in advance on mains power, and the model stays loaded longer while charging.
Klient notices when it was updated while running in the background and offers a restart.

Local AI with Ollama: mail content never leaves the computer. Klient installs and automatically updates its own copy of Ollama and the used models, lets you compare models on your own mail, and has a local-only mode that blocks cloud AI.

Multiple accounts, background mode with a tray icon, scheduled send with a countdown, snooze, calendar invitations, vacation auto-reply, drag and drop, public key attachment and import, and new AI features: ask your mail, automatic labels and a morning overview.
Unsubscribe button fixes and automatic session recovery.
Clearer status of your own sent messages.
Fixes sending messages that contain only an attachment.
Proton contacts, address suggestions and a contacts window.
First test release.
